programs.name: Diploma in Computer Engineering
programs.description: Three-year CTEVT diploma covering programming, networking, database systems, and software development. Students gain hands-on experience with modern programming languages, hardware interfacing, and IT project management.
programs.syllabus:
Year 1: Programming Fundamentals, Digital Logic, Mathematics I, Communication English
Year 2: Object-Oriented Programming, Database Management, Microprocessor, Mathematics II
Year 3: Software Engineering, Networking, Project Work, Internship
programs.intakeInfo:
Annual Intake: 48 students
Application Period: Shrawan – Bhadra
Session Start: Kartik
programs.eligibility: SEE (Grade 10) or equivalent with minimum C grade in Mathematics, Science, and English. Candidates must pass the CTEVT entrance examination.
programs.careerOpportunities: Software Developer, Network Administrator, Database Manager, IT Support Specialist, Web Developer, Systems Analyst
programs.semesterSystem: Semester system with internal assessment and final examinations
programs.scholarshipInfo: Merit-based scholarships available for top-performing students. Need-based scholarships for economically disadvantaged students.
